title: Draw an eight-byte sprite and its mirror
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge who are new to assembly
prerequisites: Basic programming loops and conditional execution
learningObjectives: Interpret each row byte as eight pixel decisions
Reverse a fixed-width bit pattern with a loop invariant
Use retained delayed branches with explicit slots
Derive row-major framebuffer addresses and bounds
Compare equivalent implementations under the same input/output contract
